name: igamma_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::igamma_(Tensor(a!) self, Tensor other) -> Tensor(a!). Computes the regularized lower incomplete gamma function into self, returns the same Tensor object and storage, and leaves other unchanged. Tests cover deterministic equal-shape and broadcast float32/float64 inputs, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, boundary values, output metadata, mutation and identity, and rejection of non-broadcastable shapes.
